// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// CATALOG
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function buildCatalog(filter='all') {
  const grid = document.getElementById('catalogGrid');
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  const list = PRODUCTS.filter(p => filter==='all' || p.type===filter);
  const countEl = document.getElementById('catalogCount');
  if (countEl) countEl.textContent = `${list.length} styles available`;
  list.forEach(p => {
    const thumb = PRODUCT_THUMBS[p.id];
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'product-card';
    const badgeCls = p.type==='pattern' ? 'pill-gold' : p.type==='print' ? 'pill-blue' : 'pill-green';
    const badgeLbl = p.type==='pattern' ? '✦ Pattern Design' : p.type==='print' ? '◈ Print Ready' : '● Solid Tee';
    card.innerHTML = `
      <div class="pc-thumb">
        ${thumb
          ? `<img src="${thumb}" alt="${p.name}">`
          : `<div class="pc-thumb-placeholder"><div class="icon">👕</div><span>${p.id}</span></div>`}
      </div>
      <div class="pc-info">
        <div class="pc-meta">
          <div class="pc-name">${p.name}</div>
          <span class="pill ${badgeCls}">${badgeLbl}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="pc-desc">${p.desc}</div>
        <button class="pc-customize-btn">
          <span>Customise this design</span>
          <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="none"><path d="M2 6h8M6 2l4 4-4 4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
        </button>
      </div>`;
    card.querySelector('.pc-customize-btn').addEventListener('click', () => openCustomizer(p));
    card.addEventListener('click', e => { if(!e.target.closest('.pc-customize-btn')) openCustomizer(p); });
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
}

document.getElementById('filterNav').addEventListener('click', e => {
  const btn = e.target.closest('.filter-tab'); if(!btn) return;
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b===btn));
  buildCatalog(btn.dataset.f);
});
document.querySelectorAll('.mode-card').forEach(mc => {
  mc.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.mode-card').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('active'));
    mc.classList.add('active');
    catalogMode = mc.dataset.mode;
  });
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// OPEN CUSTOMIZER
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function openCustomizer(p) {
  product = p;
  custMode = catalogMode;
  baseColor = p.base || '#ffffff';
  activePrint = null;
  activeColorPart = 'full';
  activePrintPart = 'full';
  zoneColors = { full: baseColor, collar:null, sleeves:null, placket:null };
  kashaActive = p.type === 'pattern';
  textLayers = []; logoUrl = null;
  currentStep = 0;

  document.getElementById('catalog-view').classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('customizer-view').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('topTitle').textContent = p.name;
  document.getElementById('topMode').textContent = { color:'Color Customiser', size:'Size Customiser', brand:'Add Branding' }[custMode];
  document.getElementById('vpName').textContent = p.name;
  document.getElementById('vpMode').textContent = { color:'Adjusting colours', size:'Custom sizing', brand:'Adding branding' }[custMode];

  buildSteps();
  renderStep(0);
  initThree();
}

document.getElementById('backBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  document.getElementById('customizer-view').classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('catalog-view').classList.remove('hidden');
  destroyThree();
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// STEPS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const STEPS = {
  color: [
    { id:'design',  label:'Choose Design' },
    { id:'color',   label:'Pick Colors' },
    { id:'preview', label:'Preview & Save' },
  ],
  size: [
    { id:'size',    label:'Select Size' },
    { id:'measure', label:'Measurements' },
    { id:'preview', label:'Preview & Save' },
  ],
  brand: [
    { id:'design',  label:'Choose Design' },
    { id:'zone',    label:'Pick Placement' },
    { id:'content', label:'Add Text / Logo' },
    { id:'preview', label:'Preview & Save' },
  ],
};

function buildSteps() {
  const bar = document.getElementById('stepBar');
  bar.innerHTML = '';
  STEPS[custMode].forEach((s, i) => {
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'step' + (i===0 ? ' active' : '');
    el.dataset.i = i;
    el.innerHTML = `<div class="step-num">${i+1}</div><span>${s.label}</span>`;
    if (i < STEPS[custMode].length-1) el.innerHTML += `<span></span>`;
    el.addEventListener('click', () => { if(i<=currentStep) renderStep(i); });
    bar.appendChild(el);
  });
}

function setStep(i) {
  currentStep = i;
  document.querySelectorAll('.step').forEach((el, j) => {
    el.classList.toggle('active', j===i);
    el.classList.toggle('done', j<i);
    if(j<i) el.querySelector('.step-num').textContent = '✓';
    else el.querySelector('.step-num').textContent = j+1;
  });
}

function renderStep(i) {
  setStep(i);
  const steps = STEPS[custMode];
  const step = steps[i];
  const panel = document.getElementById('panelInner');
  panel.innerHTML = '';

  if (custMode === 'color') {
    if (step.id === 'design') renderDesignStep(panel, i, steps);
    else if (step.id === 'color') renderColorStep(panel, i, steps);
    else renderPreviewStep(panel, i, steps);

  } else if (custMode === 'size') {
    if (step.id === 'size') renderSizeStep(panel, i, steps);
    else if (step.id === 'measure') renderMeasureStep(panel, i, steps);
    else renderPreviewStep(panel, i, steps);

  } else { // brand
    if (step.id === 'design') renderDesignStep(panel, i, steps);
    else if (step.id === 'zone') renderZoneStep(panel, i, steps);
    else if (step.id === 'content') renderBrandContentStep(panel, i, steps);
    else renderPreviewStep(panel, i, steps);
  }
}

function nextBtn(panel, i, steps, extraValidate) {
  if (i >= steps.length - 1) return;
  const btn = document.createElement('button');
  btn.className = 'btn-next';
  btn.innerHTML = `<span>${steps[i+1].label} →</span><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none"><path d="M3 7h8M7 3l4 4-4 4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>`;
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (extraValidate && !extraValidate()) return;
    renderStep(i + 1);
  });
  const wrap = document.createElement('div');
  wrap.style.cssText = 'padding:12px 20px;border-top:1px solid var(--bd);flex-shrink:0;background:var(--surface);';
  wrap.appendChild(btn);
  panel.appendChild(wrap);
}

// ─── DESIGN STEP (color + brand modes) ───
function renderDesignStep(panel, i, steps) {
  const isPattern = product.type === 'pattern';
  const isPrint = product.type === 'print';
  const isSolid = product.type === 'solid';
  let html = `<div class="panel-section">
      <div class="ps-title"><span>Design Options</span></div>`;
  if (isPattern) {
    html += `<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--tx3);line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:12px">Choose your KASHA pattern details. Use the toggle to keep or remove original artwork on the garment.</div>
      <div class="kasha-thumb-grid" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px">`;
    Object.entries(product.zones).filter(([,k])=>k).forEach(([zk, imgKey]) => {
      const url = KASHA_DESIGNS[imgKey]; if(!url) return;
      const zl = {front:'Front',back:'Back',collar:'Collar',leftSleeve:'L.Sleeve',rightSleeve:'R.Sleeve',placket:'Placket'}[zk]||zk;
      html += `<div style="border:1.5px solid ${kashaActive?'var(--ac)':'var(--bd)'};border-radius:var(--radius-sm);overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;position:relative;aspect-ratio:1" data-kt="${zk}">
        <img src="${url}" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block">
        <div style="position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);font-size:8px;color:var(--tx2);text-align:center;padding:3px;font-weight:500">${zl}</div>
      </div>`;
    });
    html += `</div>
      <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:var(--tx2);padding:10px;background:var(--bg2);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);border:1.5px solid var(--bd)">
        <input type="checkbox" id="kashaToggle" ${kashaActive?'checked':''} style="accent-color:var(--ac);width:14px;height:14px">
        Apply KASHA original artwork
      </label>`;
  } else if (isPrint) {
    html += `<p style="font-size:11px;color:var(--tx3);line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:12px">Choose an all-over print pattern and whether it applies to the full shirt or a specific part.</p>`;
  } else {
    html += `<p style="font-size:11px;color:var(--tx3);line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:12px">Classic solid T-shirt. Use the color palette and branding tools to style your tee without predefined artwork.</p>`;
  }
  html += `</div>`;

  if (isPrint) {
    html += `<div class="panel-section">
      <div class="ps-title"><span>All-Over Print Library</span></div>
      <div class="part-row" id="printPartRow"></div>
      <div class="print-grid" id="printGrid"></div>
    </div>`;
  }

  panel.innerHTML = html;

  if (isPattern) {
    document.getElementById('kashaToggle').addEventListener('change', e => {
      kashaActive = e.target.checked;
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-kt]').forEach(el => {
        el.style.borderColor = kashaActive ? 'var(--ac)' : 'var(--bd)';
      });
      scheduleBake();
    });
  }
  if (isPrint) {
    buildPrintPartRow();
    buildPrintGrid();
  }
  nextBtn(panel, i, steps);
}

function buildPrintGrid() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('printGrid'); if(!grid) return;
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  PRINT_LIB.forEach(p => {
    const url = PRINT_PATTERNS[p.key]; if(!url) return;
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'print-card' + (activePrint===p.id?' sel':'');
    card.innerHTML = `<img src="${url}" alt="${p.label}" loading="lazy"><div class="print-check">✓</div><div class="print-lbl">${p.label}</div>`;
    card.addEventListener('click', () => {
      activePrint = activePrint===p.id ? null : p.id;
      document.querySelectorAll('.print-card').forEach(c => c.classList.toggle('sel', c===card && activePrint===p.id));
      scheduleBake();
    });
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function buildPrintPartRow() {
  const row = document.getElementById('printPartRow'); if(!row) return;
  row.innerHTML = '';
  COLOR_PARTS.forEach(part => {
    const btn = document.createElement('button');
    const active = activePrintPart === part.id;
    const label = part.label === 'Full Body' ? 'Full Shirt' : part.label;
    btn.className = 'part-btn' + (active ? ' sel' : '');
    btn.textContent = label;
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      activePrintPart = part.id;
      buildPrintPartRow();
      scheduleBake();
    });
    row.appendChild(btn);
  });
}

// ─── COLOR STEP ───
function renderColorStep(panel, i, steps) {
  let html = `
    <div class="panel-section">
      <div class="ps-title"><span>Base Shirt Color</span></div>
      <div class="part-row" id="colorPartRow"></div>
      <div class="swatch-grid" id="baseSwatches"></div>
      <div class="custom-color-row" style="margin-top:8px">
        <label>Custom</label>
        <input type="color" id="baseColorPick" value="${baseColor}">
        <span class="hex-val" id="baseHex">${baseColor}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel-section">
      <div class="ps-title"><span>Color Combinations</span></div>
      <div class="combo-row" id="comboRow"></div>
    </div>`;
  panel.innerHTML = html;
  buildColorPartRow();
  buildBaseSwatches();
  buildCombos();
  nextBtn(panel, i, steps);

function getActiveColorValue() {
  return activeColorPart === 'full' ? baseColor : (zoneColors[activeColorPart] || baseColor);
}

function buildBaseSwatches() {
  const c = document.getElementById('baseSwatches'); if(!c) return;
  const selectedColor = getActiveColorValue();
  c.innerHTML = '';
  BASE_COLORS.forEach(({hex, lbl}) => {
    const b = document.createElement('button');
    b.className = 'swatch' + (selectedColor===hex?' sel':'');
    b.style.background = hex; b.title = lbl;
    if(hex==='#ffffff') b.style.boxShadow='inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.12)';
    b.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if(activeColorPart === 'full') baseColor = hex;
      else zoneColors[activeColorPart] = hex;
      syncSwatch(hex); syncColorPick(hex); syncCombos();
      scheduleBake();
      buildColorPartRow();
    });
    c.appendChild(b);
  });
  const colorPick = document.getElementById('baseColorPick');
  if(colorPick){
    colorPick.value = selectedColor;
    document.getElementById('baseHex').textContent = selectedColor;
    colorPick.addEventListener('input', e => {
      const hex = e.target.value;
      if(activeColorPart === 'full') baseColor = hex;
      else zoneColors[activeColorPart] = hex;
      document.getElementById('baseHex').textContent = hex;
      syncSwatch(hex); syncCombos();
      scheduleBake();
      buildColorPartRow();
    });
  }
}

function buildColorPartRow() {
  const row = document.getElementById('colorPartRow'); if(!row) return;
  row.innerHTML = '';
  COLOR_PARTS.forEach(part => {
    const btn = document.createElement('button');
    const active = activeColorPart === part.id;
    const partColor = part.id === 'full' ? baseColor : (zoneColors[part.id] || baseColor);
    btn.className = 'part-btn' + (active ? ' sel' : '');
    btn.style.display = 'flex';
    btn.style.alignItems = 'center';
    btn.style.justifyContent = 'space-between';
    btn.style.gap = '8px';
    btn.innerHTML = `<span>${part.label}</span><span style="width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:${partColor};border:1px solid var(--bd)"></span>`;
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      activeColorPart = part.id;
      buildBaseSwatches();
      buildColorPartRow();
    });
    row.appendChild(btn);
  });
}

function syncSwatch(hex) {
  document.querySelectorAll('#baseSwatches .swatch').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('sel',b.title===BASE_COLORS.find(c=>c.hex===hex)?.lbl));
  // simpler check by style
  document.querySelectorAll('#baseSwatches .swatch').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('sel',rgbToHex(b.style.background)===hex.toLowerCase()));
}
function syncColorPick(hex) { const p=document.getElementById('baseColorPick'); if(p){p.value=hex; document.getElementById('baseHex').textContent=hex;} }
function rgbToHex(rgb) {
  if(rgb.startsWith('#')) return rgb.toLowerCase();
  const m=rgb.match(/\d+/g); if(!m) return rgb;
  return '#'+m.slice(0,3).map(n=>parseInt(n).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('').toLowerCase();
}
function syncCombos() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.combo-pill').forEach(p=>p.classList.toggle('sel',p.dataset.base===baseColor));
}
function buildCombos() {
  const c=document.getElementById('comboRow'); if(!c) return;
  c.innerHTML='';
  COLOR_COMBOS.forEach(({lbl,base,dot}) => {
    const btn=document.createElement('button');
    btn.className='combo-pill'+(baseColor===base?' sel':'');
    btn.dataset.base=base;
    const dotStyle = base==='#ffffff'?'border:1px solid #ccc':'';
    btn.innerHTML=`<span class="dot" style="background:${dot};${dotStyle}"></span>${lbl}`;
    btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{ baseColor=base; syncSwatch(base); syncColorPick(base); document.querySelectorAll('.combo-pill').forEach(p=>p.classList.toggle('sel',p===btn)); });
    c.appendChild(btn);
  });
}

function renderTextList() {
  const list=document.getElementById('textLayerList'); if(!list) return;
  list.innerHTML='';
  textLayers.forEach((t,idx)=>{
    const row=document.createElement('div');
    row.className='text-layer-row';
    row.innerHTML=`<span class="tl-swatch" style="background:${t.color}"></span><span class="tl-text">"${t.text}" · ${ZONE_LABELS[t.zone]||t.zone}</span><button class="tl-del" data-i="${idx}">✕</button>`;
    list.appendChild(row);
  });
  list.querySelectorAll('.tl-del').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{ textLayers.splice(+btn.dataset.i,1); renderTextList(); bake(); });
  });
}

// ─── PREVIEW STEP ───
function renderPreviewStep(panel, i, steps) {
  let summaryHtml = '';
  if(custMode==='color'){
    summaryHtml=`<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px"><div style="width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:${baseColor};border:1px solid var(--bd2)"></div><span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--tx)">Base: ${baseColor}</span></div>`;
    if(activePrint){ const p=PRINT_LIB.find(x=>x.id===activePrint); summaryHtml+=`<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--tx)">Print: ${p?.label||activePrint}</div>`; }
    if(kashaActive) summaryHtml+=`<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--ac)">✓ KASHA artwork applied</div>`;
  } else if(custMode==='size'){
    summaryHtml=`<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--tx);margin-bottom:6px">Size: <strong>${selectedSize}</strong></div>`;
    const custom=Object.entries(measurements).filter(([,v])=>v);
    if(custom.length) summaryHtml+=custom.map(([k,v])=>`<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--tx2)">${k}: ${v} cm</div>`).join('');
    else summaryHtml+=`<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--tx3)">Standard ${selectedSize} measurements</div>`;
  } else {
    if(textLayers.length) summaryHtml+=textLayers.map(t=>`<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--tx2)">Text: "${t.text}" → ${ZONE_LABELS[t.zone]}</div>`).join('');
    if(logoUrl) summaryHtml+=`<div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--tx2)">Logo → ${ZONE_LABELS[logoZone]} (${logoSize}%)</div>`;
  }

  panel.innerHTML=`
    <div class="panel-section">
      <div class="ps-title"><span>Design Summary</span></div>
      <div style="background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:12px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--tx)">
        ${summaryHtml || '<span style="color:var(--tx3)">No customisations yet</span>'}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel-section">
      <div class="ps-title"><span>Download Options</span></div>
      <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px">
        <button class="btn btn-green btn-full" id="saveRender">🎨 Save 3D Render (PNG)</button>
        <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-full" id="saveUV">🗺 Save UV Texture (PNG)</button>
        <button class="btn btn-gold btn-full" id="saveBoth">💾 Save Both Files</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel-section">
      <div class="ps-title"><span>Continue Editing</span></div>`;

  // Allow jumping back to any step
  STEPS[custMode].slice(0,-1).forEach((s,j)=>{
    panel.innerHTML+=`<button class="btn btn-ghost btn-full btn-sm" style="margin-bottom:6px" data-goto="${j}">← Back to ${s.label}</button>`;
  });
  panel.innerHTML+=`</div>`;

  panel.querySelectorAll('[data-goto]').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click',()=>renderStep(+btn.dataset.goto));
  });

  document.getElementById('saveRender')?.addEventListener('click', ()=>doSave('render'));
  document.getElementById('saveUV')?.addEventListener('click', ()=>doSave('uv'));
  document.getElementById('saveBoth')?.addEventListener('click', ()=>doSave('both'));

  bake();
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// THREE.JS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function loadScript(src) {
  return new Promise((res,rej)=>{
    if(document.querySelector(`script[src="${src}"]`)){ res(); return; }
    const s=document.createElement('script'); s.src=src; s.onload=res; s.onerror=rej; document.head.appendChild(s);
  });
}

async function initThree() {
  const ov=document.getElementById('load-overlay');
  ov.style.display='flex'; ov.style.opacity='1';
  document.getElementById('load-msg').textContent='Loading 3D model…';

  await loadScript('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.128.0/examples/js/loaders/GLTFLoader.js');
  await loadScript('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.128.0/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js');

  const area=document.querySelector('.viewport');
  if(renderer) renderer.dispose();
  renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas:document.getElementById('threeCanvas'),antialias:true,alpha:false,preserveDrawingBuffer:true});
  renderer.setPixelRatio(devicePixelRatio);
  renderer.setSize(area.clientWidth, area.clientHeight);
  renderer.outputEncoding=THREE.sRGBEncoding;
  renderer.toneMapping=THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
  renderer.toneMappingExposure=1.2;
  renderer.shadowMap.enabled=true;
  renderer.setClearColor(0xf4f4f0, 1);

  scene=new THREE.Scene();
  scene.background=new THREE.Color(0xf4f4f0);

  camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(42, area.clientWidth/area.clientHeight, 0.01, 100);
  camera.position.set(0,0.15,3);

  orbit=new THREE.OrbitControls(camera,renderer.domElement);
  orbit.enableDamping=true; orbit.dampingFactor=0.07;
  orbit.minDistance=0.8; orbit.maxDistance=9;

  // Lighting for light background
  scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.7));
  const dl=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.1); dl.position.set(2,4,3); dl.castShadow=true; scene.add(dl);
  const fl=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xe8f0ff, 0.4); fl.position.set(-3,1,-2); scene.add(fl);
  const bl=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff8f0, 0.25); bl.position.set(0,-3,1); scene.add(bl);

  window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
  if(animId) cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
  (function loop(){ animId=requestAnimationFrame(loop); if(orbit) orbit.update(); if(renderer&&scene&&camera) renderer.render(scene,camera); })();

  new THREE.GLTFLoader().load('collar_t-shirt_model.glb',
    gltf=>{
      if(modelObj) scene.remove(modelObj);
      modelObj=gltf.scene;
      const box=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(modelObj);
      const cen=box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
      const sz=box.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
      const sc=2.2/Math.max(sz.x,sz.y,sz.z);
      modelObj.scale.setScalar(sc);
      modelObj.position.sub(cen.multiplyScalar(sc));
      scene.add(modelObj);
      ov.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>{ov.style.display='none';},500);
      bake();
    },
    p=>{ if(p.total>0) document.getElementById('load-msg').textContent=`Loading… ${Math.round(p.loaded/p.total*100)}%`; },
    err=>{ console.error(err); document.getElementById('load-msg').textContent='⚠ Place collar_t-shirt_model.glb in the same folder'; }
  );
}

function onResize() {
  if(!renderer) return;
  const area=document.querySelector('.viewport');
  renderer.setSize(area.clientWidth, area.clientHeight);
  camera.aspect=area.clientWidth/area.clientHeight;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
}

function destroyThree() {
  if(animId){ cancelAnimationFrame(animId); animId=null; }
  window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize);
  if(renderer){ renderer.dispose(); renderer=null; }
  scene=camera=orbit=modelObj=compositeTex=null;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// BAKER
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
let bakeTimer = null;
function scheduleBake() {
  if(bakeTimer) clearTimeout(bakeTimer);
  bakeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    bakeTimer = null;
    bake().catch(err => console.error('Bake failed', err));
  }, 120);
}

async function bake() {
  const btn=document.getElementById('applyBtn');
  if(btn){ btn.disabled=true; btn.textContent='Baking…'; }
  showStatus('Applying…');

  const off=document.createElement('canvas');
  off.width=ATLAS.W; off.height=ATLAS.H;
  const ctx=off.getContext('2d');

  // 1. Base color
  ctx.fillStyle=baseColor; ctx.fillRect(0,0,ATLAS.W,ATLAS.H);

  const li=url=>new Promise((res,rej)=>{const i=new Image();i.onload=()=>res(i);i.onerror=rej;i.src=url;});

  // 2. KASHA zones
  if(kashaActive && product) {
    for(const [zk,imgKey] of Object.entries(product.zones)){
      if(!imgKey||!KASHA_DESIGNS[imgKey]) continue;
      const z=UV_ZONES[zk]; if(!z) continue;
      try{
        const img=await li(KASHA_DESIGNS[imgKey]);
        ctx.save(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(z.left,z.top,z.w,z.h); ctx.clip();
        ctx.drawImage(img,z.left,z.top,z.w,z.h); ctx.restore();
      }catch(e){console.warn('zone fail',zk,e);}
    }
  }

  // 3. All-over print
  if(activePrint){
    const p=PRINT_LIB.find(x=>x.id===activePrint);
    if(p&&PRINT_PATTERNS[p.key]){
      try{
        const img=await li(PRINT_PATTERNS[p.key]);
        const t=document.createElement('canvas'); t.width=384; t.height=384;
        t.getContext('2d').drawImage(img,0,0,384,384);
        ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha=0.88;
        ctx.fillStyle=ctx.createPattern(t,'repeat');
        if(activePrintPart === 'full'){
          ctx.fillRect(0,0,ATLAS.W,ATLAS.H);
        } else {
          const targets = activePrintPart === 'sleeves'
            ? ['leftSleeve','rightSleeve']
            : [activePrintPart];
          targets.forEach(zoneKey => {
            const z = UV_ZONES[zoneKey];
            if(z) ctx.fillRect(z.left, z.top, z.w, z.h);
          });
        }
        ctx.restore();
      }catch(e){console.warn('print fail',e);}
    }
  }

  // 4. Text layers
  for(const t of textLayers){
    ctx.save();
    ctx.font=`bold ${t.sz}px ${FONTS[t.font]||'sans-serif'}`;
    ctx.fillStyle=t.color; ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    ctx.shadowColor='rgba(0,0,0,.35)'; ctx.shadowBlur=6;
    ctx.fillText(t.text, t.x, t.y); ctx.restore();
  }

  // 5. Logo
  if(logoUrl){
    try{
      const img=await li(logoUrl);
      const coord=ZONE_UV[logoZone]||{x:255,y:380};
      const maxW=Math.round(logoSize*(ATLAS.W/100));
      const sc=Math.min(maxW/img.width, maxW/img.height);
      const w=img.width*sc, h=img.height*sc;
      ctx.drawImage(img, coord.x-w/2, coord.y-h/2, w, h);
    }catch(e){console.warn('logo fail',e);}
  }

  // Upload to Three.js
  if(compositeTex) compositeTex.dispose();
  compositeTex=new THREE.CanvasTexture(off);
  compositeTex.encoding=THREE.sRGBEncoding; compositeTex.flipY=false; compositeTex.needsUpdate=true;

  if(modelObj){
    modelObj.traverse(node=>{
      if(!node.isMesh) return;
      const mats=Array.isArray(node.material)?node.material:[node.material];
      mats.forEach(m=>{m.map=compositeTex;m.roughness=0.8;m.metalness=0;m.color.set(0xffffff);m.needsUpdate=true;});
    });
  }

  // UV preview
  const uvc=document.getElementById('uvCanvas');
  uvc.width=120; uvc.height=120; uvc.getContext('2d').drawImage(off,0,0,120,120);
  document.getElementById('uv-preview').style.display='block';

  if(btn){btn.disabled=false; btn.textContent='⚡ Apply';}
  showStatus('Applied ✓', 2200);
}

function showStatus(msg, clearMs=0){
  const el=document.getElementById('vpStatus');
  el.textContent=msg; el.classList.add('show');
  if(clearMs) setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('show'), clearMs);
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SAVE / DOWNLOAD
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
async function doSave(type){
  showStatus('Saving…');
  await bake();
  const filename=(document.getElementById('saveFilename')?.value||'kasha-design').trim();

  if(type==='render'||type==='both'){
    if(renderer&&scene&&camera){
      renderer.render(scene,camera);
      const a=document.createElement('a');
      a.download=filename+'-3d-view.png';
      a.href=renderer.domElement.toDataURL('image/png');
      a.click();
    }
  }
  if(type==='uv'||type==='both'){
    setTimeout(()=>{
      if(compositeTex?.image){
        const a=document.createElement('a');
        a.download=filename+'-uv-texture.png';
        a.href=compositeTex.image.toDataURL('image/png');
        a.click();
      }
    }, 350);
  }
  document.getElementById('saveModal').classList.remove('open');
  showStatus('Saved! ✓', 3000);
}

document.getElementById('saveBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ document.getElementById('saveModal').classList.add('open'); });
document.getElementById('modalCancel').addEventListener('click', ()=>{ document.getElementById('saveModal').classList.remove('open'); });
document.getElementById('applyBtn').addEventListener('click', bake);
document.getElementById('dl3d').addEventListener('click', ()=>doSave('render'));
document.getElementById('dlUV').addEventListener('click', ()=>doSave('uv'));
document.getElementById('dlBoth').addEventListener('click', ()=>doSave('both'));

buildCatalog();
</script>
